Name: Ridgeside Rival Hearts - Jeric and Alex
Author: zoedoll
TagLine: Jeric and Alex rival hearts events complete with wedding and a puppy!
Description:
****Updated for 1.6 by [Airyn](https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/AirynS)!**

**Due to IRL stuff I am on a modding hiatus - I have enough time to answer comments and upload bugfixes or updates that other people give me, but not to update mods myself or add new features.****

This mod adds some romance events for Jeric (from [Ridgeside Village](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286)) and Alex, including an optional version where they get married, live together and adopt a puppy! Unlike my other Ridgeside Rival Hearts mod for Sam and Alissa, this has no option to back out and no platonic route - this is a one-way trip to Alex/Jeric town, no refunds.

_Events:_

*   **First event:** Go into town on a sunny day between 9am and 5pm. Requires 2 hearts with Alex and Jeric.

*   **Second event:** Go into Alex's house when he's there.

*   **Third event:** Go to the Log Cabin Hotel between 9am and 6pm. Requires 4 hearts with Alex and Jeric.

*   **Fourth event:** Go into Ridgeside Village after 6pm on a sunny Saturday.

*   **Fifth event:** Go into Pelican Town between 10am and 6pm on a sunny Saturday.

*   **Sixth event (married version):** Go to the Stardrop Saloon after 6pm on a Saturday.

*   **Seventh event (married version):** Three days after the proposal you will get an invitation to their wedding in the mail. Go into Pelican Town on a Sunday day to trigger it!

*   **Eighth event (married version):** Go into Pelican Town on a sunny Saturday between 9am and 5pm.
_Configuration Options:_

*   **Version**: Dating, Married or Dynamic (version will switch from dating to married automatically over time)

*   **Polyamor**y: Affects whether you can still date Jeric and/or Alex when they're married and gives you mini-events where they each react to the player dating the other (you'll only see which ever one happens first).
If you aren't using the polyamory version, I recommend adding [Platonic Partners and Friendships](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8146)  so you can see a platonic version of Alex's 10 heart event, and they're also working on a platonic version of Jeric's 10 heart event!

_Compatibility:_
May have compatibility issues with anything else that edits Alex and/or Jeric's schedules; it has built in compatibility with [Please Remember My Birthday](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6525)  (English version). Will not work with versions of Ridgeside lower than 2.0, unfortunately.

Portrait/sprite mod used in screenshots: [Diverse Stardew Valley Seasonal](https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/modpacks/8013-diverse-stardew-valley)
